Sample.evidence_source: The total score of the BAS-2 was significantly higher in men compared with women, t(1031) = 2.37, p = .021. The mean score of the BAS-2 was also compared across universities. A univariate analysis of variance showed that there was no significant between-group difference in body appreciation, F(6, 1025) = 0.69, p = .660, 2 p < .01. (Inferred N from t(1031) as 1031+2 = 1033. Inferred N from F(6, 1025) as 1025+7 = 1032. Using 1033 as the sample size for Study X.)
